title.narrative: HCFC phase-out management plan Stage II

description.narrative: The remaining eligible consumption of HCFCs in manufacturing and servicing sector is 36.9 ODP Tons. It is projected that this amount will be phased out through investment and non-investment activities and also by other interventions as stipulated in overarching HPMP strategy document approved by 66th ExCom, in the sectors as following: B) HCFC 22 phase out in the manufacturing sector - Manufacturing of household (non-ducted) split air conditioners; 1 identified company C) HCFC 22 phase out in the servicing sector training and technical assistance in the development and improving of #desert coolers#. - Update of legislation and regulatory measures.
